title: Silo Playback Protocol v3 Capability Response
description: Response body of GET /api/v1/playback/capability, mirroring CapabilityResponseV3 in internal/playback/protocol_v3.go. A client reads this before its first start request so it plans against what the server actually advertises instead of a compiled-in assumption. Protocol v3 is the server's only playback protocol, so enabled is always true; there is no disabled response shape.

protocol_versions.description: Protocol versions this server speaks. A client picks the highest it supports rather than assuming a single value, which is what keeps a future v4 from breaking v3 clients.

features.description: Server feature flags. The list grows additively within v3, so an unrecognized entry is expected and must be ignored, not treated as an error.

deliveries.description: Serving routes the planner may return. The list contains the server's currently executable delivery classes and grows additively.

transformations.description: Server-executed transformations available to the planner. Client-executed transformations are declared by the client in its start request, not listed here.

reason.description: Reserved optional diagnostic for a future non-rollout condition. It does not disable protocol v3; enabled remains true.

recipe_version.description: Identity of the recipe, not a semantic version to compare. A client matches it exactly or declines the transformation.

validated_claims.description: Neutral statements about the bytes the transformation produces, so a client reasons about the output without knowing the server's toolchain.
